Shemariah = "kept by Jehovah" a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him…
Mattithiah = "gift of Jehovah" a Levite who presided over the offerings a Levite…
Sarai = "princess" original name of Sarah the wife of Abram or Abraham
Zebina = "bought" a son of Nebo who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
